display_name: UIC Property All Risks wording (Quy tắc bảo hiểm mọi rủi ro tài sản): insuring clause, exclusions A and B, under-insurance, deductible, and General Conditions 1-13

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated by tools/vnsrc.py quote from line N of ../../source/raw/uic-par.txt, and in short runs that tools/vnsrc.py check verifies occur verbatim in that file. GLOSSARY.md maps every Vietnamese term to its English identifier.

source.rendering_note: pdftotext -layout of the PDF, byte-identical to a fresh rendering made on 2026-10-06. BRIEF.md gives the PDF's sha256 for the text; the text's own is rendering_sha256.
source.authority: the insurer's standard-form wording, published on uic.vn; private contract terms, not law

scope: The whole document: the insuring clause (time of cover, the defined term Tổn thất, the basis of payment, the proviso limiting liability), Exclusions A1-A4 and B1-B5, Under-insurance, the deductible and the undertaking not to insure it, and General Conditions 1-13. Inert: the title, the endorsement-substitution sentence, the headings, A3(c) severability, General Condition 1, and the page footers. Reached and refused: the conditions-precedent words of the insuring clause and General Condition 6's rateable proportion. Everything the document leaves to the Schedule, every assessed figure and every finding of fact is an input. See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

forks.F1: Cover begins at the later of the first premium and the first day of the Period in the Schedule; the clause itself names no first day (finding 11).
forks.F2: '12 giờ đêm của ngày cuối cùng' is the end of the last day.
forks.F3: A Loss must be physical, accidental, sudden and unforeseen (the defined term), not only accidental and sudden (finding 18).
forks.F4: Which terms are conditions precedent 'so far as their nature permits' is not answered; broken terms with no stated consequence are declined by name.
forks.F5: A1 and A2 reach the causal chain; A3 and A4 reach every cause, concurrent ones included (finding 16).
forks.F6: 'A cause not excluded' is a cause on no section A list (with the property's circumstances) and not a B3(f)-(h) or B5 cause; an earlier loss is judged on this property's circumstances.
forks.F7: 'nổi loạn' has one meaning in A3(b) and in B1's carve-back (finding 1).
forks.F8: B1(a) property not specially stated is excluded whatever the peril.
forks.F9: Storm ('bão tố') is not within A1(d)(iv)'s wind and rain.
forks.F10: B3(a) 'xe lăn' is rendered rolling stock.
forks.F11: B5 reaches explosion or rupture of any apparatus of the class.
forks.F12: B4 is read as covering only the excess over what other policies would have paid alone (finding 2).
forks.F13: B3(i) is property specifically insured under a separate policy; B4 and GC 6 apply to other insurance generally (finding 2).
forks.F14: 'Giá trị' and 'số tiền của thiệt hại' are assessed inputs; no valuation basis is chosen.
forks.F15: Each cap is per loss and an aggregate for the Period; nothing restores it (finding 13).
forks.F16: The item cap, the total cap and the limit all apply.
forks.F17: Order per item: B4, then Under-insurance, then GC 6, then the item cap.
forks.F18: Under-insurance uses the sum insured as stated, not as eroded.
forks.F19: The deductible comes off after the caps (finding 12).
forks.F20: GC 6's rateable proportion has no stated basis: declined unless the amount is already nil.
forks.F21: GC 8(a)'s change of trade carries no increase-of-risk qualifier (finding 8).
forks.F22: GC 8(b) ends cover once the building has been unoccupied more than 30 days by the time of the loss.
forks.F23: GC 9(b)'s 30 days run from awareness of the event; day 30 is in time.
forks.F24: 'ngay lập tức' is an open standard, a finding on the claim.
forks.F25: GC 12's 'pending or in arbitration' is tested when the twelve months run out; a rejected claim is not pending (finding 3).
forks.F26: 'tháng' is a calendar month, by add months (clamping).
forks.F27: The Insurer's notice ends the Policy 30 days after sending; that day is unexpired for the refund and uncovered for a loss.
forks.F28: The Insured's written request takes effect on the date it names.
forks.F30: GC 4(a) forfeits all benefit under the Policy on any fraudulent claim (finding 15).
forks.F31: B1's carve-back applies where a named peril is anywhere in the chain.
forks.F32: GC 7's two two-month windows keep their different anchors (finding 4).
forks.F33: A3(d)'s proviso lifts A3(d) only; other limbs still apply.
forks.F34: B3(g)'s machinery or equipment includes electronics and pressure apparatus.
forks.L1-L15: Fifteen points where the Law on Insurance Business 08/2022/QH15 may fill or override the wording (average basis, late-notice sanctions, the one-year filing period, the 15-day payment period, intentional non-disclosure, grounds for termination, contra proferentem, double insurance, assessment costs, force majeure, change of risk, form of indemnity, wear and tear, subrogation, abandonment). Recorded in NOTES.md section 3; none is resolved in the L4.

self_check.vnsrc_check: vnsrc check: 350 src: lines, 512 Vietnamese runs, 0 problems (python3 -I tools/vnsrc.py check ../../source/raw/uic-par.txt *.l4 COMPARABLES.md GLOSSARY.md NOTES.md SOURCE-LICENSE.md; the briefed *.md also takes in BRIEF.md, whose line 31 is 1 problem not of this encoding: NOTES.md section 7)

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source. No independent test pass has been run (the row was briefed as one session with no sub-agents). Every expected value in uic-par-tests.l4 and uic-par-findings.l4 was written by the same session that wrote the rules, worked by hand from the wording before it was asserted.
